description:
Intetics Inc., a leading American technology company specializing in custom software application development, distributed professional teams creation, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is on the lookout for a Lead ServiceNow Developer to join our team and provide exceptional customer support.

Responsibilities

  • Configure and customize ServiceNow Vulnerability Management / USEM components.
  • Develop technical solutions based on business and security requirements.
  • Build and maintain Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, and Flow Designer workflows.
  • Configure dashboards, reports, and automation capabilities.
  • Design and implement integrations with security and compliance tools.
  • Support testing, defect resolution, deployment, and technical documentation.
  • Collaborate with architects, product owners, and security stakeholders.
  • Participate in knowledge transfer and handover activities.
  • Strong hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript within ServiceNow.
  • Proven experience with Flow Designer, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, and UI Policies.
  • Experience implementing REST and SOAP integrations.
  • Strong understanding of ServiceNow workflows and automation.
  • Experience working in Agile project environments.
  • Ability to independently implement developer user stories with minimal supervision.
  • English level: B2 (Upper-Intermediate) or higher.

Nice to have

  • Experience with ServiceNow Security Operations (SecOps), Vulnerability Response, or Vulnerability Management.
  • Familiarity with Qualys, Microsoft Azure CSPM (Cloud Security Posture Management), or Cribl.
  • Understanding of Configuration Compliance and hardening processes.
  • Experience with CMDB, CI relationships, and MID Server integrations.
  • Understanding of ServiceNow USEM architecture.
  • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) certification.
  • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Vulnerability Response (CIS-VR) certification.
